reviews.text:
We boarded our dog, Buddy, at Dog Dude Ranch for 17 days. When we brought him home, we immediately noticed a distinct patch of hair loss and skin abrasion on his leg that was not present when we dropped him off.
Minor friction rubs can happen in boarding environments, but transparency and attentive supervision are baseline expectations. Staff never mentioned the issue at pickup. When I reached out via email asking if staff had noticed it during his stay and requested care/incident notes, management repeatedly evaded those direct questions. Instead, they sent canned boilerplate text about chronic elbow calluses and deflected responsibility.
If a facility cannot tell an owner whether a physical change was documented over a 17-day stay, it signals either inadequate daily supervision or a culture of avoiding open communication out of liability defensiveness. Trust is critical when leaving a pet for an extended period, and the lack of proactive care and accountability here means we will not be returning.

Last time my dog stayed here a few years back, my dog returned with a limp. This time he returned home throwing up, having diarrhea, and was diagnosed with hook worms. The ranch is already more costly, but I had to pay an additional $1000+ in vet bills. To make things worse it’s possible for humans to contract hook worms so now I have to get tested at the doctor as well. I like the idea of my dog being able to run around in a large area but not at this expense.

I’m very picky about where I leave my dog because I don’t like traditional boarding facilities where dogs spend most of the day in cages and only get a few minutes outside. That’s why I was so happy to find this farm style dog  boarding .

They offered me a complimentary day of daycare from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and the experience was amazing. The property is beautiful, and the dogs are supervised by multiple staff members throughout the day. They carefully match dogs with others that have similar personalities, and the dogs spend more than two hours playing outside before resting with classical music.

When I picked up my dog, he looked genuinely happy and didn’t want to leave. I was shocked that he didn’t want to leave because he was adopted from an abusive situation and is normally nervous about going out. He had never reacted that way before, so I felt confident that he had been treated with kindness and really enjoyed his stay.

This is one of the few places in Miami where dogs can safely enjoy a farm like environment and plenty of outdoor play. I will definitely be returning and WILL Definitely board my dog here in November.

Excellent place for your family pet to enjoy a day of fun, make new friends, enjoy the beautiful grounds,  chickens,  horses. For over night stays.  Indoor kennel with AC. Staff is amazing and very knowledgeable.  Open seven days a week, great hours for drop off and pickup. I gladly recommend Dog Dude Ranch. Amazing place for your dog to be safe, secure, and best of all, place to hang out with friends and have fun. Easy five stars.
Excellent service, my dog ​​was well taken care of.

This place is just too cool! You can quite literally send your dog to a dude ranch in horse country. While I explored the Everglades, my dog Mister Beau got to play with other small pups in a large grassy yard; shaded with large trees and filled with doggy shade structures, a jungle gym, and sprinklers. There’s chickens, chicks, cats, and horses on the property so your dog gets to experience exciting new sights and smells and learn the farm life, just like a dude ranch! During the thunderstorm this afternoon, they had relaxing music playing in the barn to soothe the dogs. It was like an actual daycare at nap time. Just too cute! Mister Beau even got a free bandana, so he’s officially a member of the dude ranch pack! I appreciate the friendly and informative staff who were always hard at work keeping the dogs happy, cool, and clean.

Very disappointed on the last time I left my dog there. I reserved with months in advance around February and when I arrived they told me I was not able to pick up my dog on Monday May 25 because it was a holiday. I was not advised about it until I drop off my dog. They said it was a system glitch and they had not realized it and on top of that they charged me for the day. I never receive pictures of my dog in any stays previously but in the last stay they sent me a picture and it was not even my dog they shared they use a third party overseas and they are not familiar with the dogs they just send the messages. I am leaving out of town again but since May 25 I have still waiting to receive an apology email; text or call and/or a refund for the extra day they charged me; I have found another place to leave my pet; seen they seem not interested in my business.
I don’t want to change the comment because this was an issue I had; however I would like to shared that Tina one of the owners reach out to me to find out about the problem and she apologized and shared that thanks to my review she learned about this issue. She also refunded me and assured me this won’t happen again. She was very understanding and sounded really concerned and made me feel valued throughout the conversation. I usually do more good reviews than bad because I know how important reviews are now a day to businesses and I updated the review and give them back their 5 stars because they reach out and made me change my mind about how I feel about them. I look forward to a better experience next time I leave ghost with them.

WARNING: DONT GIVE THEM YOUR DOG UNLESS YOU WANT THEM IN THE BEST CARE! They are the best! Their home was clean, they have a nice backyard for the dogs to play. They gave us pictures and updates on my dog. My dog was in the best care when I picked her up. 100/10 would come back!
Excellent place where dogs enjoy free open place to run and play. Good care for your dog. !
Couldn’t be happier with the daycare service. You can tell they love what they do here and it shows in the quality of care

We took advantage of the daycare free offer and now will become a frequent
Customer. All from the staff to the facilities
Were perfect for the dogs and the owner.
My dogs loved staying there. I could tell they were happy and having fun and they sure weren't excited about leaving when I picked them up.
I've been taking my dogs here for years. Great facilities and excellent staff.
A great place with great care for our dog.
Absolutely fantastic! Both dogs loved it! Staff was great!! Can’t say enough positive about our experience!

Amazing facility! Flo Made it the best experience possible. I’m in Georgia and my mother is in Miami. My mother is about 80 years old and is not technically🤪 technologically inclined however flo treated her as if it was her mother.
Flo if you’re reading this thank you so much for all you did! I have no way to repay you!

The owners of this company should really pay attention to this girl. She’s got something.😇
What an amazing experience we had bringing our dog here. The facility, the staff and attention was excellent. The dog was extremely happy when we picked up.

Sasha, our 3 year old beagle had a great time at the ‘ranch’! It was her first time boarding and we were afraid that she would be upset with the separation … we were quite wrong. The various activities, staff and terrific outdoor areas really pleased her! We’ll be back!

Our dog loves to run and play with other dogs at Dog Dude Ranch.  He also loves people. He must get loving attention when he is there because he does not seem at all needy when we pick him up after a vacation.  He also knows when we are driving him there to leave him because he gets excited when he is within a miile of the ranch, We like how they protect our dogs by verifying that all dogs have their vaccinations.  The personnel are absolute dog lovers,
Great, friendly staff . Our dog comes home smelling fresh after every stay .

The staff is professional and love what they do. They wait for your pet with open arms. They greet you by name. They make you feel like family. My dog loves going every time.  She is well taken care of and loves playing with the other dogs. Highly recommend. ♥️♥️♥️

We've boarded our dog on several occasions at Doggie Dude Ranch.  The people there are wonderful and our dog loves going there.  I've been able to check on my dog while we've been away and the office staff is always responsive.  I highly recommend the Doggie Dude Ranch and we will definitely board our dog again with the utmost confidence.  They are fantastic!
Nice, clean and plenty of space to play and run. Nice and professional staff
Excellent place with very friendly staff! They have lots of space for the dogs and my pup came home ready to sleep & relax. I’ll board here every time!
My dog enjoyed her first visit. The facility is beautiful, and staff is very friendly. Looking forward to her next visit.

Today my Frenchie spent the day at the ranch and absolutely loved it! The staff was warm, professional, and made us feel right at home. I toured the facility and felt completely confident leaving him there. I even got adorable photos of him running around with new friends. He’ll definitely be back for a longer boarding stay, I feel great about leaving him in their care!
Our dog, Daisy, loves this place!!! And us too!

This is our 2nd time leaving our precious puppies with the Dog Dude Ranch. Both times we had ana incredinble experience. Our dogs cam,e back home happy. We had peace of mind while they were there. They sent us pictures, kept us informed, everything a dog owner needs. Thank you, we can't recommend it enough!
Second time using dog dude ranch the staff always friendly and attentive with your needs
Thank goodness for Dog Dude Ranch! Our dog Suki is so happy when she stays there and we have peace of mind that she’s well taken care of and gets plenty of exercise and socialization.
My canine friends had a beautiful time and we hope to see you again.   Dream and Rex had a wonderful time . We the parents love Dog Dude Ranch as the best place for any dog to be.
The best place

We enjoyed a weeklong vacation with confidence that our Lucy (Doberman) was happy and healthy with her human and canine friends at dog Dude Ranch.  We always make DDR a part of our vacation plans. They are terrific.
Always amazing, they take amazing care of your dogs and keep you updated. Also, they treat all the dogs with love and care! Highly recommended! I wish I could give more than 5 stars.
Great price and employees seemed like they genuinely cared !
The happiest place on earth.

Dog Dude Ranch…the name just makes you want to tell people about them!

I give them five enthusiastic stars, what a place, all staff we interacted with were professionals and went above and beyond.

We wish Pluto could tell us about his week and a half he spent in Miami’s horse country….

Keep up the amazing work, Dog Dude Ranch!
Kenny, USVI

My dog Nellie and I are so lucky to have found dog dude!! I just came back from my trip abroad and will wholeheartedly say that they have the BEST team. Katie has been especially supportive and communicative and I can’t thank her and the team enough!! Will be leaving Nells here for all my travels when I have to ❤️❤️

I cannot express enough how wonderful everyone at Dog Dude Ranch has been and how lucky our dog Pluto was to have been there.
We were in the midst of relocating our dog and had to leave him in the Miami area last minute. From the beginning, everyone was so helpful and kind to us — Katie, Karen, Tia, Jane, Florence and so many other names I am likely forgetting. Each one of you was super communicative and so helpful every step of the way. And getting reports on how Pluto was doing put our minds at ease. I quickly knew that Pluto was in great hands and having a great experience.
We would definitely recommend Dog Dude Ranch to anyone who needs to have a home away from home for their beloved dog(s).
We hope to have Pluto back there someday as we know he was treated well and had a blast!!

Our Labradoodle Max has stayed with The Dog Dude Ranch several times. He always returns home to us happy and healthy. We are so grateful to be able to drop Max at a place where they take such great care of while we travel. We highly recommend this amazing safe space where dogs can roam freely and play in the fresh air.

We have consistently had a great experience at Dog Dude Ranch. Every time we visit we are greeted by warm, friendly staff and afterwards our dog comes home happy and healthy. Would absolutely recommend to others.
Boarding for years and have never regretted it.

My husband & I were very pleased with the care that our pet received.  The staff and the owner were all very loving.  Our pet is a senior.  Special attention is given to seniors & pets with disabilities.  I even received a photo of our pet while she was at Dog Dude.  The guests have ample space to run around.  In short, I definitely recommend dog Dude Ranch.
Great staff, very good with my puppy,  love and recommend this place highly

This was our second time boarding our pet mini schnauzer, But this time was for a week and In every picture the Dog Ranch sent us she just seemed to be having a good old time
With her friends
Happy place for dogs. Nice people good employees. I can be relaxed on vacations knowing my dog is there.

I've left my dog ​​there twice. From the photos, she looks like she has a lot of fun. The place is very nice and the staff is friendly.
The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because you have to ask them to send photos of your dog instead of them sending at least a couple of photos each day. I understand they have a lot of dogs, but I'd be happier to receive daily updates, even if it's just a snapshot of a moment in the day; it makes a big difference. Anyway, I recommend it.

My dog was a bit nervous when we dropped her off but all the staff were very loving and helpful.  By the end of the day, she was having a wonderful time playing with all her new friends!  Planning an overnight stay next and I feel confident that she will absolutely love it!
Our dogs always come home tired and happy! They have so much fun and are well taken care of.
Great place to leave you furry family member if needed! They are well taken care of with Dog Dude Ranch! Been going to them for over 10 years!
Our basenji dogs just started going here but the staff is amazing. Just so welcoming and flexible to the needs and attitudes of our pups. Really happy we found this place.

My Vizsla has boarded at the Dog Dude Ranch a number of times this year, and each time she has been excited to arrive and seems very happy and healthy at pick-up! Being an active and social dog she LOVES to have the freedom to be outside and playing all day. The staff are sweet, and the business-side of the service efficient. They also provide a delivery service for a reasonable extra fee which we have been happy with. Highly recommend the ranch if your pup is like ours!

Oliver is happy when he sees that we are headed to Dude Ranch . He doesn’t even look back , he loves it . And he always very happy when he sees us but he just had a great gateaway .. Very thankful to be able to have you . 😊 …
Wonderful caring people!
They are incredible!! We haven’t even boarded with them yet, but we took our new adopted baby there to do the initial screening and they were absolutely amazing!!! We will definitely be booking soon!
A wonderful place for your dog to run and play around with other dogs in a large natural grass area!
There is nowhere better to board your dog. Period!
Vivianis loved it!!! Thank you so much for taking care of Vivi and making her feel at home ❤️❤️

Very disappointed. We read lots of good reviews and had high expectations. We dropped off on Saturday morning and barely got any updates/photos for 4 days. We were charged $30 for a bath after we filled out the forms and checked “no bath.” And our dog weighed 7lbs and came back probably 2 lbs heavier and begging for water. She drank a ton of water when we picked her up. They also give them dinner at 2pm. Nothing good to say.

Dog Dude Ranch is amazing? I love the fact that dogs can run freely and play with other dogs without having to get into a pool.  I didn't like that concept from the other place I used to leave my dog at. The staff at Dog Dude Ranch is super friendly, accommodating, and very professional.  I'm glad that I was finally able to schedule my dog for boarding and will also be bringing her to day care, at least once a week.  I also love the fact that I can just show up and bring my dog for day care without having to schedule it. Additionally, I appreciate that Dog Dude Ranch does not require you to pay a deposit upfront in order to schedule boarding.

If you are looking to leave your dog overnight while you go on vacation, look no further than Dog dude ranch. They are very professional, responsive and extremely caring. Their accommodations are impeccable and very well thought out. They separate the dogs by sizes and require proof of vaccination and flea/tick prevention medicine for all their pet guests, which honestly gives such piece of mind. Your dog will never be confined to a crate but rather will have space to run and play and at bedtime will have a secure room to sleep in with a litter mate. It’s literally a home away from home. What gave me piece of mind that my dog was well cared for is my dogs excitement to return the following day after the initial meet and greet. Can’t recommend them enough!

I recently took my two dogs to Dude Dog Ranch in Miami for full-day daycare, and they absolutely loved it! The staff was friendly and attentive, and the space was perfect for them to play and socialize. I could tell they had a blast, and I felt great knowing they were in good hands. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fun and safe place for their dogs!
Everyone is really nice! I love nice people 🥰. Thank you for always taking care of my little best friend 🐶 …

Needed a place for our precious in the midst of a family emergency
They were wonderful! Loving. Caring. And amazing property. Our puppy was well cared for!
Lacy & Auri are absolutely worn out. The staff was great. We absolutely appreciated the pictures & updates.

An absolutely wonderful place. Beautiful facilities and property, friendly and knowledgeable employees, user friendly website, informative introduction.

I felt really good about Diesel staying there from everything I saw on the website but once I got there I realized it was perfection
Our dog loves Dog Dude Ranch!! Plenty of friends and there are always staff who watch the different groups of dogs.

Hi Maggie - Our hearts go out to your dear pup. We replied to you by email on January 31st so I am wondering if it went to your junk folder. Can you please check it and let us know if you found it as we are here to help you?
Great first experience! Will be looking forward to bringing our dogs here in the future!
They answered every concern. I had on my first day. I recommend them.
Very clean, beautiful grounds, very friendly staff
Our dog had so much fun he didn’t want to leave !

Roxie had a great time at the ranch. She was well taken care of, healthy and in terrific shape after her three weeks stay.  I place complete confidence in the ranch to look after my cherished pet every time I travel. Highly recommended by me (and Roxie)!

I cannot say enough great things about The Dog Dude Ranch in Miami! Leaving my 4lb puppy with anyone other than family for the first time was terrifying, and I was equally worried about my 13-year-old dog who is prone to overheating and seizures. The team at The Dog Dude Ranch immediately put my fears at ease. They were incredibly understanding, attentive, and made sure to address all my concerns.

Throughout the stay, they sent me pictures and updates to let me know both dogs were doing well, which made such a difference. I’ve now left my dogs with them four times, and every experience has been wonderful. I’m no longer as anxious or scared because I know my dogs are in the best hands.

What sets them apart is their incredible attention to detail. The staff uses walkie-talkies to stay in constant communication, so everyone knows exactly what’s going on with each dog at all times. It’s clear they genuinely care about the animals and take every precaution to ensure their safety and comfort.

The Dog Dude Ranch is the only place I trust with my dogs, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and professional boarding experience. Truly an incredible place!

I’ve done doggy daycare with them but this was my first experience with boarding. My dog had a great experience and they are very focused on detail. They don’t do picture updates like some other places but they were very responsive when I inquired about how my dog was doing. Would definitely choose them again!
It is the best place to keep your dog safe when traveling.  I’ve been using them for over two years.  I highly recommend.
World class care and very well run

First time I left my senior Beagle in this place. Everything seems to have worked fine. Only reasons I didn't rate 5 star is because I couldn't get them to send any pics while I was away for ten days, and the dog seemed to have a dog bite inside his ear (nothing serious though). I will use again.
This is our favorite boarding facility for our pups. They absolutely love going. We love the natural environment and the staff is always so kind and attentive.
I have been coming here since the 90’s. They love dogs and have always catered to my special requests. I use them about twice a year. Dean is great!
This is a wonderful facility. The staff is amazing and grounds are extensive, clean and peaceful. Dogs are well-cared for and come home happy.
Best place ever...I travel alot and I know my Zoey is well taken care of.

This is the only place I will leave my Sadie at.  They take very good care of her and she has a fun time each visit.  They keep them safe and healthy during their stay.  We have now been going for years and I fully recommend it for parents who love their fur babies.

Absolutely the best boarding facility in Miami-Dade. They go above and beyond for you and your pets. Amazing company.
They helped me so much during hurricane Milton after I evacuated. They waited for me after hours to board my 2 dogs, after a long delay on the road due to the increased traffic. I can’t thank them enough for the support in they gave me in that difficult and uncertain time.
They’re the best.
Thank you for looking after Paloma she was nervous but very happy when I picked her up. I really appreciate it
My dog always looks forward to going to the Ranch!! The staff is very friendly and informative. I’m grateful for all you do!!

Great time dropping off two dogs here for day camp. They enjoyed the property and staff. Nice property with lots of shade and big play areas. When we arrived, we were greeted relatively quickly but also saw signs directing us to office where staff also was. Noticed staff outside with dogs during playtime during drop off which was nice to see the dogs supervised during play time. Horse barn converted into nice large rooms for dogs during nap time and overnight boarding. Will be a returning customer.
Always responsive and attentive to detail, great personnel, and most importantly, safe, fun, and wonderful care for our beloved Manolo 😊 …

Love this place. I'm very close to my dog. He is a Covid dog meaning that he grew up with me working at home and was still happy as could be when we brought him home. My dog summer camp forever. No ticks, fleas or any of that.

I just got home from a long trip, and I could say I almost don't recognize my dogs after a week at the Dog Dude Ranch. I could swear they look younger. They are both little old guys who are not so active anymore. And after a week at the ranch they are both happy, running, and playing!This was more than a "resort" for both. Their coat is shiny and their eyes are bright. This is the healthiest they have looked in months, especially my little diabetic guy. This week at the ranch did wonders for him. His blood sugar numbers are the best for the first time after being diagnosed last year. I couldn't be happier with the way they look and feel after their little "summer camp" this week and am extremely grateful to everyone at the ranch❤️❤️❤️

My first choice for boarding whenever needed. We have a Labrador Retriever who loves to play with other dogs and water. Dog Dude Ranch is an amazing choice for him. The idea of him not spending hours in a cage while we are enjoying a …
Dude Ranch is "dog heaven". Very professional staff. Found the perfect place for my Lexi.
